intro: Ruvo pairs solid craftsmanship with architectural balance. Crafted from mango wood and finished in a deep brown tone, it brings practical storage and contemporary presence into modern spaces.

features.title: Spacious tabletop for everyday functionality
features.text: Ruvo coffee table’s generously sized surface offers ample room for books, décor, trays, and daily essentials. Its balanced proportions make the table equally suited for relaxed evenings and styled living spaces.

features.title: Robust solid-wood construction
features.text: Built entirely from mango wood for both the top and understructure, Ruvo delivers dependable strength and long-term durability. Its sturdy build ensures stable performance in everyday use.

features.title: Built-in shelf for organised storage
features.text: A thoughtfully integrated lower shelf provides practical space for magazines, remotes, and accessories. This feature helps maintain a clutter-free tabletop while keeping essentials within reach.

features.title: Meticulously crafted architectural detailing
features.text: The distinctive base blends sculpted wooden panels with slim vertical supports. This layered construction creates visual depth while maintaining structural balance and stability.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
